name: uk-public-research-agent
description: Tool-calling research agent over Companies House and Police UK, with MCP servers, tracing, and an offline eval harness.

scripts.demo: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/main.js demo
scripts.eval:replay: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/main.js eval --mode replay
scripts.eval:live: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/main.js eval --mode live
scripts.eval:local: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/main.js eval --mode local
